# Tarmeer

> Tarmeer is the UAE's interior design & renovation platform connecting homeowners with verified design companies, experts, and material suppliers in Dubai and across the UAE.

## Guides & Insights
Data-driven guides on renovation cost, material sourcing, design trends, and real client stories — grounded in real platform project data and verified experts.
- Insights hub: https://www.tarmeer.com/insights

## Core sections
- Design & renovation companies: https://www.tarmeer.com/companies
- Verified experts: https://www.tarmeer.com/experts
- Material suppliers: https://www.tarmeer.com/materials
- Project portfolio: https://www.tarmeer.com/portfolio
